FN-WJ0GE9-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 473
Committee: Child and Senior Advocacy Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/22/2023
House Bill 473 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of (1) the
respective local law enforcement agencies to investigate if an infant surrendered pursuant to
this bill is a child reported as missing in this state or in another state; and (2) the Alabama
Department of Public Health (ADPH) to adopt rules relating to the installation, maintenance,
and monitoring of baby safety devices.
Further, this bill would allow certain emergency medical services providers to install and
maintain baby safety devices, and respective signage, if a specific donation by a private party
or legislative appropriation is made for this purpose. ADPH estimates the cost of a baby
safety device to be $10,000.
